caption: The drawing shows a side view of a carousel horse, oriented to the right, with its legs bent as if leaping. The horse is primarily white with black hooves and a black mane and tail. It wears a bridle with green and gold coloring and a red circular ornament on the side of its head. The saddle is tan with a red seat, adorned with small white designs and patterns, and sits above a red blanket decorated with white, symmetrical geometric patterns and bordered in yellow and green. The body of the horse features additional green, gold, and black straps and decorative elements, including signals of carved or painted detail near the saddle area. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or scenery.
title: Carousel Horse
